verdict.summary: Approve bounded specification only. Candidate and pinned instruction hashes match. Contract preserves R3 and actual registration/storage boundaries: genuine revalidated context, immutable bounded same-process samples, audit-only SQL history, original deadlines, transactional authority checks and conservative Windows unknowns. Collector-lifetime nonce is a sound conservative refinement with no restart reuse or OS boot-UUID claim. Native implementation, atomic-claim verification, actual overlap, installed pilot and Task5 execution acceptance remain outside this review; tests were not rerun.
